## Activity

This report summarises site activity at River Outreach for April 2024. During the month, the site recorded 68 captures. The activity figure provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 68 captures, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 10.3 per cent. This indicates that a defined proportion of the images could not be used for grading. The ungradable count and rate are presented together to support review of image quality at the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 9 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Taken together, these results describe the volume of activity, the number of images unavailable for grading, and the grading outcomes recorded during April 2024.
